lines.en: : Come in, Sensei! Door is open!
I walk into Io's room and, just as always, do not hesitate to comment on the condition of the place.
lines.zh: 我走进 Io 的房间，和往常一样，毫不客气地评价起屋里的状况。

lines.en: She gives me the same excuse as always, that it's really all Uta's fault, but she is undeniably an accomplice to this.
lines.zh: 她照例搬出那套说辞，说真的全是 Uta 的错——但不可否认，她也是共犯。

lines.en: I understand the need for a place to do all of her crafts and whatnot, but isn't there somewhere like a woodshop in the[school] she could use?
lines.zh: 我理解她需要一个地方做那些手工之类的东西，可[school]里就没有个木工房之类的地方给她用吗？

lines.en: That would certainly beat trying to build anything in this extremely cramped space.
lines.zh: 那总比在这么逼仄的地方硬做东西强。

lines.en: But, then again, she's proven thus far that she's not really the type to willingly spend any spare time somewhere like that.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，到目前为止她已经证明了，她绝不是那种会主动把空闲时间花在那儿的人。

lines.en: And it's not like the clutter really affects me in any way since I'm not the one living here.
lines.zh: 再说反正住在这儿的人又不是我，这些杂物对我其实也没什么影响。

lines.en: But I {i}would{/i} greatly appreciate it if she'd at least clear an area around the bed so I don't need to tap into my athletic capabilities each time I sit on it.
lines.zh: 但如果她至少能把床周围清出一块地方，让我每次坐下时不必动用运动能力，我{i}会{/i}感激不尽。

lines.en: Io eventually convinces me to watch a movie with her and, lo and behold, I need to squeeze through the paperthin opening once more.
lines.zh: Io 最后说服我陪她看部电影，你瞧，我又得从那条薄如纸的缝隙里挤过去一次。

lines.en: She sits close enough to me that our shoulders touch but makes no effort to go any further.
lines.zh: 她坐得离我很近，肩膀都贴到了一起，却没有任何进一步的举动。

lines.en: I'm still struggling to understand why she's so comfortable around {i}me{/i} of all people, but I benefit from this- so I will not question it out loud.
lines.zh: 我至今没弄明白，她为什么偏偏在{i}我{/i}身边这么自在；但我是受益的一方——所以我不会把这疑问说出口。

lines.en: I'll just let her have her fun and humor her by pretending to watch whatever she puts on.
lines.zh: 我就随她高兴，配合着装出在看她放的东西的样子。

lines.en: At the end of the day, I {i}did{/i} come here to see her. So letting her do what she wants is fine by me.
lines.zh: 说到底，我来这里{i}就是{/i}为了见她。所以让她做想做的事，我没意见。
